requester.say: Open a request with a receipt: under the receipt, “What is on this receipt” shows each line and where it goes. A question “Is this yours?” shows at the top of your request.

stock_manager.say: Open a request with a receipt: under the receipt, “What is on this receipt” shows each line and where it goes.

approver.say: On a request with a shared receipt, each request is checked against its own share.

finance.say: Paying by bank transfer? Under the transfer, “Same supplier: pay these together?” lists other approved requests to that supplier.
